cohort: 39,187 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies in the Norwegian Mother and Child Cohort Study (2000-2009)
finding: Exercise during pregnancy, particularly at frequencies >5 times per week and high-impact types, was associated with a reduced risk of acute cesarean delivery in first-time mothers.
mod_finding: Regular exercise and high-impact exercises during pregnancy are associated with a reduced risk of acute cesarean delivery in first-time mothers.
